## Description

Trains a gradient-boosted tree ranking/regression model to order assets by expected relative return rather than simply classify market direction.

## Where it may fit

Large equity or multi-asset universes with heterogeneous nonlinear interactions among features.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, factor and market-neutral portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time fundamentals, prices/momentum, liquidity, sector features, forward-return labels, costs and chronological cross-validation.

## Caveats

Must evaluate rank IC and net portfolio returns out of sample; tree feature importance does not prove causality and rankings can turn over excessively.
